title: Is AI bad for the environment? #ai
description:
Is AI bad for the environment? Let's fact-check, and look at the stats on artificial intelligence technology such as ChatGPT, Claude and Gemini. Are they ruining the planet? Using too much electricity and water? Well, it turns out your environmental impact as an AI user is both way bigger and smaller than you might think.
